newsitem.title: USA: Columbia executive in Florida court - FBI.
newsitem.headline: Columbia executive in Florida court - FBI.

text.p: At least one executive of Columbia/HCA Healthcare Corp has surrendered on federal charges and appeared before a judge in Fort Myers, Fla., the FBI said.
"I think one of the defendants is in court in Fort Myers as we speak," Bob Chiaradio, asstistant agent in charge of the Tampa FBI office, said. He declind to identify the defendant or the charges.

Earlier, the U.S. Justice Department said a federal grand jury had indicted three Columbia/HCA executives on charges of conspiring to submit false cost reports under Medicare and the U.S. military's Civilian Health and Medical Program on behalf of Fawcett Memorial Hospital in Port Charlotte, Fla., from 1986 until June 1997.
